metadata.description: Marketplace for qa-e2e-pilot (the browser-QA engine) + qa-kit (a step-gated QA process shell built on it).

plugins.name: qa-e2e-pilot
plugins.description: Browser-driven end-to-end QA that verifies a feature's full stack, not just the screen: drives the UI, bakes (reads persisted state back at multiplicity 0/1/N), independently recomputes the feature's calculations and business rules against the spec oracle, probes the backend when the UI lies, and checkpoints a resumable memory trail.

plugins.name: qa-kit
plugins.description: A spec-kit-style, step-gated QA process shell over qa-e2e-pilot: constitution → spec → scenarios → analyze → run. Each step produces a human-reviewable artifact and populates the engine's existing gate inputs; qa-e2e-pilot stays the verification engine. Co-installs qa-e2e-pilot via dependencies.
